responsibility: This machine-description file defines the SPARC backend’s operand constraints used by reload/LRA and instruction recognition. It classifies SPARC register subsets, immediates, floating-point constants, aligned memories, and special 32-bit ldd/std register-pair cases, providing the constraint letters referenced throughout sparc.md and sync.md so patterns can select legal registers, constant forms, and memory operands for SPARC code generation.
